depth-alpha.displayName: Well Depth Ladder (cyan alpha encodes distance)

chrome-scrim.displayName: Chrome Scrim Set (neutral alphas, deliberately hueless)

act.purpose: The full-bleed section words (WORDS / SONGS / CODE / SOUTH). 13% opacity watermark on Southern grounds; full strength and glowing on wire. Type as image, one per viewport.

craft.purpose: The hero's rotating word in its slot, and the pinned triptych panel words.

body.purpose: All reading copy, Courier Prime. Line-height 1.9 is what keeps a typewriter face readable at length. 65-75ch measure.

tag.purpose: Numbered section tags and HUD labels. Uppercase, tracked 0.24em. Never a sentence.

reel-lead.purpose: The lead line inside the horizontal rail section.

reel-caption.purpose: Card captions under rail imagery, amber, one step below tag because a caption sits under an image rather than heading a section.

shadows.name: object
shadows.purpose: Photographs and slabs that have grown into place. Deep and soft because the object is genuinely closer to the viewer.

shadows.name: glow
shadows.purpose: The CTA and any lit element on the wire ground.

shadows.name: hud-hairline
shadows.purpose: Corner consoles and the sound toggle: a hairline edge, not a border.

shadows.name: mark-drop
shadows.purpose: Each exploded wordmark piece, so the pieces read as separated in depth.

motion.name: lenis-duration
motion.purpose: Lenis smooth-scroll weight (library stock). GSAP's ticker drives Lenis on one clock; two loops disagree frame to frame and read as jitter.

motion.name: ease-standard
motion.purpose: Default easing for chrome state transitions.

motion.name: grow-entrance
motion.purpose: Photographs and the lightform. Content enters by depth, never translateY alone.

motion.name: mark-intro
motion.purpose: The exploded wordmark assembling on load. Runs alone; the scrubbed scroll tween is armed only after it completes (with a 2600ms failsafe, since rAF is frozen in hidden tabs).

motion.name: mark-scrub
motion.purpose: The wordmark coming apart on hero exit. The ease supplies the click on reverse, replacing a competing snap tween that used to fight the scrub.

motion.name: rail-scrub
motion.value: scrub 0.8, pin from top top, invalidateOnRefresh
motion.purpose: The pinned horizontal triptych. A 0.18-duration hold precedes the travel so the first panel can be read before it moves.

motion.name: well-breath
motion.purpose: The genome's rest cycle: the corridor camera breathes on this period when not scrolling.

components.name: CTA
components.description: Solid cyan block, black text, square corners, cyan bloom. The only filled button in the system.
components.css: .ds-cta { display:inline-block; font-family:'Courier Prime', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size:.74rem; letter-spacing:.24em; text-transform:uppercase; text-decoration:none; padding:1rem 2.2rem; border:0; border-radius:0; background:#40C4E8; color:#06080C; box-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(64,196,232,.4); transition:box-shadow .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1), transform .6s cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-cta:hover, .ds-cta:focus-visible { transform:translateY(-2px); box-shadow:0 0 64px rgba(64,196,232,.7); }

components.name: HUD Console
components.description: Fixed corner panel: blurred dark fill, hairline inset edge, Courier micro-caps. Bottom-left names the section; bottom-right is a live scroll percentage in cyan.
components.css: .ds-hud { position:relative; display:inline-block; padding:7px 11px; text-decoration:none; border-radius:0; background:rgba(8,10,14,.55); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px); backdrop-filter:blur(8px); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.16); } .ds-hud span { font-family:'Courier Prime', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.18em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#EAF2F6; white-space:nowrap; } .ds-hud:hover { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(64,196,232,.85); }

components.name: Sound Toggle
components.description: The harp unlock. Sound never starts on its own: browsers require a gesture and unannounced audio is hostile, so this button IS the unlock and the preference is remembered.
components.css: .ds-harp { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; cursor:pointer; padding:7px 13px; border:0; border-radius:0; background:rgba(8,10,14,.55); -webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(8px); backdrop-filter:blur(8px); box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.16); transition:box-shadow 600ms ease; } .ds-harp:hover, .ds-harp[aria-pressed="true"] { box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(64,196,232,.85); } .ds-harp-txt { font-family:'Courier Prime', ui-monospace, monospace; font-size:10px; letter-spacing:.2em; text-transform:uppercase; color:#EAF2F6; } .ds-harp[aria-pressed="true"] .ds-harp-txt { color:#40C4E8; } .ds-harp-wave { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:2px; height:12px; } .ds-harp-wave i { display:block; width:2px; height:3px; background:#EAF2F6; opacity:.6; }

components.name: Seal
components.description: Fixed circular mark in the top-left. The only round object in a square-cornered system, which is why it reads as a stamp rather than a button.
components.css: .ds-seal { display:grid; place-items:center; width:38px; height:38px; border-radius:999px; background:rgba(0,0,0,.62); box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,.22), 0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.6); transition:box-shadow 900ms cubic-bezier(.2,.8,.2,1); } .ds-seal:hover, .ds-seal:focus-visible { box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(64,196,232,.85), 0 0 22px rgba(64,196,232,.5); } .ds-seal img { width:18px; height:auto; }

components.name: Act Word
components.description: Full-bleed section word, overflow-clipped. 13% opacity on Southern grounds, fully lit with a double glow on wire. Type behaving as image, never as a heading.
components.css: .ds-act { margin:0; font-family:Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight:900; font-size:clamp(3.4rem,17vw,13rem); line-height:.86; letter-spacing:-.055em; color:#1B1916; opacity:.13; overflow:hidden; } .ds-act[data-ground="wire"] { color:#40C4E8; opacity:1; text-shadow:0 0 40px rgba(64,196,232,.5), 0 0 90px rgba(64,196,232,.25); }

components.name: Chromatic Word
components.description: The WORDS panel word, split into red and cyan channels that separate on scroll. Uses multiply, not screen: on a paper ground screen lightens the fringes to white and the effect vanishes.
components.css: .ds-chroma { margin:0; position:relative; font-family:Archivo, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight:900; font-size:clamp(2.6rem,8vw,5.8rem); letter-spacing:-.045em; color:#1B1916; } .ds-chroma span { position:relative; display:inline-block; } .ds-chroma span::before, .ds-chroma span::after { content:attr(data-text); position:absolute; inset:0; mix-blend-mode:multiply; opacity:.42; } .ds-chroma span::before { color:#E01B1B; transform:translate(var(--ab,0px),0); } .ds-chroma span::after { color:#00B7D8; transform:translate(calc(var(--ab,0px) * -1),0); }

components.name: Grow Figure
components.description: Photograph or type slab entering from depth. Sizing is keyed on structural position rather than the animation class, so changing how a figure arrives can never change how large it renders.
components.css: .ds-grow { margin:0; perspective:1100px; } .ds-grow img { display:block; width:100%; height:auto; aspect-ratio:4/5; object-fit:cover; box-shadow:0 40px 90px -28px rgba(0,0,0,.7); transform:translateZ(-520px) scale(.42); opacity:0; transition:transform 1200ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), opacity 1200ms; } .ds-grow.is-in img { transform:none; opacity:1; } .ds-grow.is-wide img { aspect-ratio:auto; object-fit:contain; }

components.name: Spine
components.description: Fixed left route-map nav with a progress fill, blended with mix-blend-mode: difference so it stays legible over both poles without needing a background. Hidden below 760px.
components.css: .ds-spine { position:fixed; left:18px; top:50%; transform:translateY(-50%); mix-blend-mode:difference; } .ds-spine-track { display:block; width:1px; height:180px; background:rgba(255,255,255,.22); } .ds-spine-fill { display:block; width:100%; background:#BEBEBE; transform-origin:top; transform:scaleY(0); } @media (max-width:760px) { .ds-spine { display:none; } }

narrative.overview: Two poles, held in tension on one page. The South is warm, physical, worn: paper grounds, rust and amber, real photographs, cardboard and felt and scratches. The future is a deep-sea instrument panel: near-black grounds, one electric cyan, hairline HUD edges, a receding grid that falls away under your feet. The site earns its interest by cutting hard between them rather than blending them into a comfortable middle. There is no serif anywhere. The voice is a matte grotesque (Archivo, at heavy weights, tracked tight) against a typewriter (Courier Prime) for every label and every line of body copy. The one exception is the JS the WLD wordmark itself, which is an image asset, a stacked interlocking Didone lockup, white on transparency, which is why any ground it sits on must be dark. This system explicitly rejects: the previous editorial/Didone-body world (warm eggshell everywhere, italic serif display, porch-letter restraint), generic AI-slop SaaS marketing, and any crypto/blockchain visual language.
keyCharacteristics: Contrast flips section to section - paper, dusk, electric, paper, black. Never a gradient between poles.
Depth is real: CSS perspective, translateZ, a rotated ground plane, and three independently parallaxing texture layers.
Things arrive by growing toward the viewer, not sliding up the page.
Type is the artwork; imagery is evidence.

rules.name: The Two-Pole Rule
rules.body: Every section commits to South or future. Rust and amber never appear on the wire ground; cyan never appears on paper. A section that uses both is a section that has decided nothing.

rules.name: The Cut, Not the Fade Rule
rules.body: Grounds change by hard edge between sections. No gradient transitions between paper and night - the jolt is the point.

rules.name: The No-Serif Rule
rules.body: No serif face ships on a surface built in this world. Not for quotes, not for emphasis, not for warmth. The warmth comes from color, texture, and photography.

rules.name: The Z-Axis Rule
rules.body: Content enters by scale and depth (translateZ(-520px) scale(.42) to identity), never by translateY alone. Things grow out of the screen.

rules.name: The Depth-Ladder Rule
rules.body: Inside the well, cyan alpha encodes distance - it is the depth cue, not decoration. Changing one rung in isolation breaks the read of distance: move the ladder, not a step.

rules.name: The Hueless-Chrome Rule
rules.body: Chrome uses neutral alpha scrims that tint whatever ground they sit on rather than introducing a hue. Adding a hue to chrome is drift; adjusting a neutral alpha is not.

dos: Do flip ground and text color completely at every section boundary.
Do enter content along Z (grow toward the viewer) with 1100-1400ms ease-out.
Do keep texture below 0.11 opacity - depth, never pattern.
Do reserve cyan for the future pole and the CTA.
donts: Don't slide content up the page as the default entrance.
Don't put rust/amber on the wire ground or cyan on paper.
Don't reintroduce the retired editorial world (eggshell-everywhere, italic Didone body, taped-photo motif as the primary language).
Don't gradient between the two poles to ease the transition.
